summary: Credicorp Ltd. filed a Form 6-K material event reporting that its subsidiary Banco de Crédito del Perú (BCP) received Peruvian SBS authorization to acquire 100% of Helm Bank USA via two newly incorporated entities, Orange Per Holding S.A. and Orange Financial Holding Inc. Terms (price per share, premium, implied value) are not disclosed. The transaction remains subject to U.S. regulatory approvals from the Florida OFR and the Federal Reserve, plus customary closing conditions. Watch for regulatory timeline and potential risk-arb spread if price emerges; no advisor or board recommendation cited. This is a non-US filing mapped to a material event current report under the 1934 Act.
